critics.strongest_case:
The diagnosis exonerates Pass 2d, and the exoneration is exactly what its unmeasured populations would most likely overturn.

Its conclusion is that of thirty-six flagged rows only five are Pass 2d's fault and the rest are upstream text, catalog wording, Pass 2c, or accepted decisions. Trace what that rests on and every load-bearing beam is a population nobody looked at.

The corrective instrument is Terra. Terra is 100% canary (2,019 of 2,019 verdict-joined rows; all eight production artifacts, 813 rows, have no v5 block, and none of the 1,277 production artifacts on disk has one either).
